The '''Trade Outpost''' was a settlement on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TradeOutpostSWG.jpg|250px|thumb|The Dathomir Trade Outpost]]
The outpost was little more than a small, enclosed settlement. Some notable structures within the confines of the outpost included a humble tavern and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].

==History==
Throughout [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Trade Outpost was frequented by many outsiders, mainly to trade in Dathomiri resources.

Some notabe residents of the outpost during this time included [[Wallaw Loowobbli]], [[Singular Nak]], [[Russell]], and [[Nirame Sakute]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Trade Outpost was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Trade Outpost was one of three small outposts on Dathomir that had its own spaceport. The other two settlements that had a spaceport in the game were the [[Science Outpost]] and the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]].
